howto.name: Upload an MKV file
howto.text: Drop an .mkv file. Matroska commonly holds H.264 or H.265 video.

howto.name: PrivaTools re-encodes via FFmpeg
howto.text: The video is re-encoded as H.264 and the audio as AAC, even when the MKV already holds H.264.

howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Run the conversion. MP4 is the container Safari, iOS, Windows and most TVs expect. Because the video is re-encoded, expect a small quality loss and a different file size.

faq.q: Does MKV to MP4 re-encode the video?
faq.a: Yes. Every file is re-encoded to H.264 video (CRF 23) and AAC audio, even when the MKV's streams would already fit in an MP4, so it is not a lossless container swap. Only one audio track is kept.
MP4 plays natively on phones, browsers, TVs, and editors; MKV is a flexible container but far less universally supported.
No. Uploaded videos and outputs are temporary and deleted after the response.
